links.targetTitle: A Spell deployed with CREATE2 automatically fails validation
Validators must not trust the Spell repository's own tooling
Ecosystem Spell Validation deliberately checks less than dev

title: Compiler version, EVM version and optimization settings are validated as part of the Spell artifact
content:
Three checks cover the build environment. Optimization (A.1.10.2.4.12.3.1.7) must read `No with 200 runs`, "unless explicitly required due to contract size constraints"; if enabled, `Yes with 200 runs` unless the Instruction Document specifies a run count that "must be a multiple of 100 other than 0." Anomalous values such as "`No with 13767 runs`" or "`Yes with 0 runs`" fail validation. The EVM version (A.1.10.2.4.12.3.1.8) must show "Default" or the compiler's correct default — for Solidity 0.8.16, "London." The compiler version (A.1.10.2.4.12.3.2.2) should match the pragma in `DssSpell.sol`, with only the major version needing to match.

Why metadata is treated as security-relevant: identical Solidity source can produce different bytecode under different compiler versions, EVM targets or optimizer settings. A source-level diff — the check most validators would consider decisive — is therefore not sufficient to establish that the deployed contract behaves like the reviewed source.

The approach is to insist on *canonical, boring* settings rather than to reason about which deviations are dangerous. A multiple of 100 other than zero, a default EVM target, the pragma's compiler: values that make anomalies self-announcing. The specific examples given as failures — an oddly precise run count, or zero runs with optimization enabled — are unusual rather than obviously exploitable, and that is the point. They indicate something non-standard happened, which is enough to stop the Spell without anyone having to prove intent.

This is the same anomaly-detection logic the Executive Sheet applies to prose (A.1.10.2.4.2.1.3): keep everything identical to last time so that whatever differs is worth a question.
description: A.1.10.2.4.12.3.1.7 and .8 fail a Spell on non-standard optimization runs or a non-default EVM version, treating build metadata as security-relevant rather than incidental.
